description: This file implements a plugin module for a Lighttpd server, providing server status and statistics endpoints with HTML, JSON, and text formats. It handles configuration, generates status pages, and tracks server metrics.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Holds plugin configuration URLs and sorting option.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Maintains runtime server metrics, configuration defaults, and state for the status plugin.

methods.name: mod_status_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data structure, allocating memory for runtime metrics.

methods.name: void mod_status_merge_config_cpv(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * const cpv)
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into plugin_config.

methods.name: void mod_status_merge_config(plugin_config * const pconf,const config_plugin_value_t * cpv)
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values into plugin_config based on array of values.

methods.name: void mod_status_patch_config(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Prepares and updates the plugin configuration based on per-request conditions.

methods.name: mod_status_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for the plugin, including URLs and sorting options.

methods.name: void mod_status_header_append_sort(buffer * b,const plugin_config * const pconf,const char * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Appends table header cell with optional sorting link and arrow.

methods.name: void mod_status_get_multiplier(buffer * b,double avg,int size)
methods.description: Converts a numeric value into a human-readable unit (k, M, G, etc.) and appends to buffer.

methods.name: void mod_status_html_rtable_r(buffer * const b,const request_st * const r,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Appends a row to the server status HTML table with details of a request.

methods.name: void mod_status_html_rtable(request_st * const rq,const server * const srv,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Generates the entire connection and request table in the server status HTML page.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_html(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Handles the request to produce the full server status HTML page.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_text(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p)
methods.description: Handles the request to produce server status in plain text format.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status_json(server * srv,request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p)
methods.description: Handles the request to produce server status in JSON format, optionally wrapped for JSONP.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_statistics(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles the request to produce server statistics in plain text.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handle_server_status(request_st * const r,const plugin_data * const p,const plugin_config * const pconf)
methods.description: Dispatches sending server status in HTML, JSON, or text based on query.

methods.name: void mod_status_row_append(buffer * b,const char * k,size_t klen,const char * v,size_t vlen)
methods.description: Utility to append a table row with key and value.

methods.name: void mod_status_header_append(buffer * b,const char * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Utility to append a header row with key.

methods.name: handler_t mod_status_handler(request_st * const r,void * p_d)
methods.description: Main URI handler for the status plugin, routing to specific sub-URLs.

methods.name: mod_status_trigger
methods.description: Periodic trigger to update server metrics and sliding averages.

methods.name: mod_status_account
methods.description: Updates metrics after a request completes.

methods.name: int mod_status_plugin_init(plugin * p)
methods.description: Plugin initialization function called when loading the module.
